assumptions.text: Pre-shipment inspection priced at $268 per man-day.
assumptions.label: sourced

assumptions.text: AQL 0 / 2.5 / 4.0 for critical / major / minor is the usual consumer-goods setting; agree it with the buyer and factory.
assumptions.label: estimate

assumptions.text: One inspector checks about 100 units per day including functional tests.
assumptions.label: estimate

sample_size.label: estimate
sample_size.source_or_assumption: Per ISO 2859-1 table (edition not verified): Table I code letter K for lot 1,201–3,200, level General II, Table II-A

defects.description: Accessible plywood edges or corners are sharp or splintered, or have a radius visibly below the specified minimum.
defects.spec_ref: Tolerance: All accessible edges rounded r ≥ 2 mm
defects.check_method: Visual and tactile check; verify suspect edges with radius gauge — AQL 0: accept ≤0 / reject ≥1 at n=125

defects.description: Anti-tip wall anchor kit is missing, incomplete, or cannot be securely attached to the table as provided.
defects.spec_ref: BOM m6 (Anti-tip wall anchor kit) / Electronics block b4 (Anti-tip anchoring provision)
defects.check_method: Verify kit contents and perform assembly and attachment check — AQL 0: accept ≤0 / reject ≥1 at n=125

defects.description: Raised safety guard is missing, loose, cracked, or has a sharp or exposed edge that could injure a child.
defects.spec_ref: BOM m2 (CNC-cut birch plywood changing-surface deck and raised safety guards, 18 mm) / Tolerance: All accessible edges rounded r ≥ 2 mm
defects.check_method: Visual and tactile check; check guard attachment by hand — AQL 0: accept ≤0 / reject ≥1 at n=125

defects.description: Frame, deck, or shelf dimensions or fitting-hole positions are out of tolerance, preventing correct assembly or leaving components misaligned.
defects.spec_ref: BOM m1 (CNC-cut birch plywood frame panels, 18 mm) / BOM m2 (CNC-cut birch plywood changing-surface deck and raised safety guards, 18 mm) / BOM m3 (CNC-cut birch plywood lower shelf, 18 mm) / Tolerance: CNC-routed panels ±0.3 mm / Tolerance: Hole positions for fittings ±0.2 mm
defects.check_method: Measure panels and hole locations with calipers or a suitable gauge; perform assembly fit check — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: Fasteners are missing, incorrect, or do not secure the frame, guards, or shelf firmly after assembly.
defects.check_method: Verify fastener set and perform assembly and hand-stability check — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: Changing pad is missing, damaged, or does not sit correctly on the changing surface.
defects.spec_ref: BOM m4 (Wipe-clean changing pad) / Part p2 (Changing pad (wipe-clean foam))
defects.check_method: Visual inspection and fit check on the changing surface — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: Visible scratches, dents, or uneven lacquer coverage mar the finished plywood surfaces without affecting function.
defects.spec_ref: BOM m7 (Water-based wood lacquer) / Part p1 (Birch plywood panels and legs)
defects.check_method: Visual inspection under D65 light at 50 cm — AQL 4: accept ≤10 / reject ≥11 at n=125

defects.description: Shipping carton or protective packing is torn, crushed, or insufficiently protecting the product, with no resulting product damage.
defects.spec_ref: BOM k1 (Corrugated shipping carton and protective packing)
defects.check_method: Visual inspection of carton and protective packing — AQL 4: accept ≤10 / reject ≥11 at n=125

inspection_man_days.label: estimate
inspection_man_days.source_or_assumption: 125 samples at 100 units per man-day incl. functional tests

inspection_cost.label: estimate
inspection_cost.source_or_assumption: V-Trust rate (Sourced) × estimated man-days: 2 man-days (estimate) × $268/man-day (V-Trust, https://www.v-trust.com/en/our-network, checked 2026-09-26)
